# blastshield_device_security_postures (Data Source)

Lists Blastshield device_security_postures with optional filters.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (List of Number) Filter by id.
- `name` (List of String) Filter by name.
- `pinned_devices` (List of String) Filter by pinned_devices.
- `system_tags` (List of String) Filter by system_tags.
- `tags` (List of String) Filter by tags.

### Read-Only

- `device_security_postures` (Attributes List) List of device_security_postures matching the filters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--device_security_postures))
